schemaVersion.description: Major version of the schema this document follows. See data/schema/README.md.

municipalityId.description: 5-digit local government code (全国地方公共団体コード without the check digit). Used for municipalities (Yokohama City is 14100, Setagaya is 13112) and for the wards of designated cities (Aoba-ku, Yokohama is 14117). MLIT N03 boundary data (N03_007) and e-Stat use the ward code where there is one.

areaId.description: Ward code (designated cities) or municipality code (everywhere else), a hyphen, and the 6-digit e-Stat small-area code (S_AREA) for the town or chōme. Together they form the 11-digit e-Stat KEY_CODE.

slug.description: Lowercase identifier, stable across bundle versions.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes served.

langTag.description: BCP 47 language tag, kept to language and an optional script or region.

localizedText.description: Text keyed by language. Japanese and English are required; other languages may be added.

names.description: Display and search names. kana is the reading in hiragana or katakana, used for search and sorting.

validity.description: Effective date range in Japan time. Both ends are inclusive. Omit valid_to for open-ended.

commonCategory.description: Small shared set that drives icons and colours. Every municipal category maps to one of these.
